name: @water-backend/backend
description: Crowdsourced water quality report system API

scripts.test: cross-env NODE_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=test-secret JWT_EXPIRES_IN=1d OPENWEATHER_API_KEY=dummy-key jest --runInBand
scripts.test:watch: cross-env NODE_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=test-secret JWT_EXPIRES_IN=1d OPENWEATHER_API_KEY=dummy-key jest --watch --runInBand
scripts.test:coverage: cross-env NODE_ENV=test JWT_SECRET=test-secret JWT_EXPIRES_IN=1d OPENWEATHER_API_KEY=dummy-key jest --coverage --runInBand
scripts.test:performance:report: npx artillery run --output ./src/tests/performance/results.json ./src/tests/performance/water-source-load.yml && npx artillery report ./src/tests/performance/results.json
